title: Normalized rational localization data
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and the global finite-field datum $D$ with geometric field $k$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $X$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme and let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion and $j:U\to X$ an open immersion [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. The normalized rational localization data is the type of tuples specified below; this definition does not assert that a tuple exists. Use the integral categories of [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed] and their raw rationalizations of [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi].

A tuple contains a proof that $\ell$ is a unit in $k$, finite-type $k$-structures on $U,Z$ making $i,j$ morphisms over $k$, quasi-compactness of $j$, and residue-field invertibility of $\ell$ on $X,U,Z$. Its closed rational image is a functor from the rational category of $Z$ to that of $X$. The four functors are the recorded pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], ordinary closed integral direct image [def-weil-derived-direct-image], and extension by zero given by the compactification $(j,\mathrm{id}_X)$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], with their strict-system realization [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization] and normalized compact-support action on all Hom maps [def-weil-compact-support-finite-action].

For each operation the tuple records an additive, $\mathcal O_E$-linear integral functor with an exact shift structure, an additive rational functor with an exact shift structure, its literal integral object formula, its map on every scalar pure tensor, compatibility with the localization shift comparison, and $E$-linearity on all rational arrows. It records integral and rational adjunctions $j_!\dashv j^*$ and $i^*\dashv i_*$, fixes the integral open counit and closed unit by their whole coherent-system equations, and fixes all four rational unit and counit components to the localized integral components. For each integral distinguished completion of that open counit and closed unit it records a rational distinguished completion with third arrow the localized third arrow followed by the localization shift comparison. For arbitrary independent rational objects $N$ on $U$, $M$ on $Z$ and any integer $m$, it records vanishing of $\operatorname{Hom}(j_!N[m],i_*M)$ and of its integral cross Hom tensored with $E$, together with the unique additive identification characterized on all localized pure tensors after the specified object and shift transports.

The auxiliary definitions are: the identity direct-image comparison given by uniqueness of right adjoints to the normalized identity pullback; the pullback-to-whole-reduction comparison; the normalized open realization using the compact-support comparison followed by that identity comparison; the exact rationalized-functor record just described; and the generator-characterized cross-Hom predicate. These are data types and constructions, without an existence assertion.

lean.statement:
structure SfRationalLocalizationOrthogonality (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u})
    {Z U X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (j : U ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsOpenImmersion j]
